messages.message:
According to the fictional Northaven Instruments returns policy, you may return unused beakers in unopened original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a refund of the goods. You would need to pay the return postage unless the items are faulty or were sent in error.

To start a return, email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and reason for return. You will then receive a returns number and label within one working day.

Is there anything else I can help with?
